Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding: Clearscope evidence upload & SIG subset request

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this — were starting the security review with Redwood and I wanted to get ahead of the portal onboarding so its not a blocker for the procurement team. We typically share the following in our Vendr/Whistic profile:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted)
- SIG questionnaire answers (we can submit full SIG or a minimal subset your team prefers)
- CAIQ map for our cloud deployment
- Evidence files: network diagrams, encryption policy, KMS key rotation proof, and sample incident playbook

Two quick questions:
1) Do you prefer the full SIG export or a curated "minimal SIG" focused on data handling and crypto controls?
2) Can we upload samples to your Vendr claim (I created a draft: https://vendr.io/portal/claim/CLR-98231) or would you rather we send a signed bundle to an S3 presign you manage?

I attached a short SOC2 summary to speed up review. We can schedule a 20-min sync if thats easier.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Security Operations
Clearscope, Inc.

Attachments: clearscope-soc2-summary-2026.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@clearscope.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding: Clearscope evidence upload & SIG subset request

Alicia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Wed prefer a minimal SIG subset for the initial pass (items covering access control, encryption, logging, and incident response). If you can tag which SIG sections are excluded, that speeds triage.
- Vendr claim is fine — please mark the upload as "Redwood review" and reference "CLR-98231" in filenames. We keep evidence short for the first pass (we can expand if follow-ups are needed).
- For KMS proofs, a signed metadata snippet or rotated-key audit log (redacted) is sufficient — no raw key material.

Marissa: can you validate the minimal SIG checklist below?
Kimberly: FYI — procurement will need the Signed PO and terms once legal finishes redlines; we might ask for a short one-week extension if evidence review pushes timelines.

Proposed timeline: clearscope uploads today or tomorrow, Redwood finishes initial review by EOD Thursday (Nov 5), follow-ups next week. Does that work?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Minimal SIG checklist (requested for initial upload): AC-1, AC-2, AC-6, IM-1, IM-2, DI-1, SEF-1, SEF-2, CR-1

Thanks — that timeline is reasonable. Well do the minimal SIG subset and upload two things to the Vendr claim: the redacted SOC2 bundle and a focused evidence folder with KMS rotation logs and our incident playbook. Files will include the claim id in the filename (CLR-98231).
